title: Origin of Adjustment Team: Philip K. Dick's bathroom light chain replaced by a switch
summary: Riz Virk tells of Origin of Adjustment Team: Philip K. Dick's bathroom light chain replaced by a switch, about 1950s at Philip K. Dick's home (unspecified), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Tessa, his wife, she told me that he came up with the idea for that story, which eventually became the movie The Adjustment Bureau, with Matt Damon and Emily Blunt, because he went into the bathroom and there was a light that he had turned on and off many times.

plain: A researcher named Riz Virk says that Tessa Dick, wife of the science fiction writer Philip K. Dick, told him how Dick got the idea for his 1950s story Adjustment Team, later the movie The Adjustment Bureau. According to her, Dick went into his bathroom to pull a light chain he had used many times and found a switch there instead, as if reality had been quietly edited. Virk tells it as a hint that we might live in a simulated or changeable world.
